number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant is accused; the judgment concerns one convicted person.

accused_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation of the appellant is not stated.

previous_criminal_record.quote: sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment for 10 days vide Ex. P-33
previous_criminal_record.reason: Prior s.309 conviction is supported, but it is not described as a general criminal record.

victim_gender.reason: The deceased is referred to as male (brother, 'his').

victim_age.reason: The deceased's age is not given in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: The appellant and deceased are brothers.

offence_category.reason: Charged as murder under s.302; the final classification is culpable homicide, which the category reasonably reflects.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.302, s.304 Part I, s.300 Exception 1, s.309; Evidence Act ss.8, 25, 27, 106; CrPC s.313
statutory_provisions.quote: Section 106 of the Evidence Act7 gets attracted
statutory_provisions.reason: Core IPC sections are right, but s.309, Evidence Act ss.8, 25, 27, 106 and CrPC s.313 are omitted.

weapon.reason: A pick-axe was seized on disclosure and found blood-stained.

evidence_type.correct_value: Medical, circumstantial, and disclosure/recovery evidence; no eyewitness to the act
evidence_type.quote: Kumari Madhu Nirmalkar (PW-10) did not profess to having made any such statement, or that she had seen the appellant committing the offence.
evidence_type.reason: Medical and circumstantial evidence are right, but no eyewitness saw the offence, and recovery evidence is omitted.

confession.correct_value: Confession is inadmissible as proof; only the identification of the maker and the s.27 discovery portion are admissible
confession.quote: the confession is inadmissible as proof of confession is prohibited under Section 25
confession.reason: The value implies the confession was admitted, but the judgment holds it inadmissible except for identification and s.27 facts.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: Dashrath Nirmalkar's addiction to alcohol, and that he was extremely abusive and ill-tempered
aggravating_circumstances.reason: The judgment treats the deceased's alcohol addiction and abuse as provocation, not aggravating circumstances.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Loss of self-control from grave and sudden provocation, without premeditation, is supported.

trial_court_outcome.reason: The appellant was convicted under s.302 IPC by the trial court.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court (Criminal Appeal No. 400 of 2013, judgment 25.02.2019) affirmed the conviction
high_court_outcome.quote: We are in agreement with the High Court and the trial court.
high_court_outcome.reason: The judgment shows a High Court decision on 25.02.2019 that the Supreme Court agreed with, not 'Not applicable'.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeal partly allowed; conviction converted to s.304 Part I IPC; sentence modified
final_outcome.reason: 'Convicted' omits that the appeal was partly allowed and the conviction converted to s.304 Part I.

offence_finally_established.reason: Conversion to Part I of s.304 supports culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Sentence modified to the period already undergone; no fixed term specified
imprisonment_type.quote: we are inclined to modify the sentence of imprisonment to the period already undergone
imprisonment_type.reason: The judgment does not impose a fixed term; it modifies the sentence to time already served.

imprisonment_years.quote: the appellant has already suffered incarceration for over 10 years
imprisonment_years.reason: The judgment says over 10 years served, not an exact 10-year sentence.

fine_rs.reason: A fine of Rs. 1,000/- is stated.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral facts with no outcome or reasoning, e.g. the accused was the deceased's brother; the deceased was an alcohol-addicted abuser; the night-time quarrel; the pick-axe; the accused's suicide attempt; the trial conviction; and the appeal pending
neutral_facts.quote: the conviction was converted to s.304 Part I IPC under Exception 1 to s.300 IPC due to the provocation
neutral_facts.reason: Facts reveal the court's outcome, sentence, and reasoning (provocation, no premeditation), violating the neutral-facts rule.

offence_severity.correct_value: Life imprisonment (s.302 sentence); six months default term; no minimum stated
offence_severity.quote: sentenced to undergo imprisonment for life
offence_severity.reason: Life imprisonment and six-month default are supported; a 6-month minimum is not stated as a legal minimum.

attempt_completion.reason: Murder was completed, with fatal injuries causing death.

physical_harm.reason: Coma from shock and multiple skull fractures are described.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Convicted under s.302 IPC, converted to s.304 Part I IPC; separate s.309 conviction

number_of_offences.reason: The s.302 conversion is right, but 'upheld under s.304' is wrong and the s.309 conviction is omitted.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property or financial loss is discussed in the judgment.

premeditation_planning.reason: The court held the act was without planning or premeditation, reflecting temporary loss of self-control.

motive.reason: Prosecution relied on the deceased's abuse and alcohol addiction to show motive.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Presence together that night and chain of circumstances are as stated in the judgment.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Hostile public witnesses deposed the brothers stayed in separate rooms; PW-9 and PW-10 are important as they were present at the incident

witness_credibility.reason: Importance of testimony is attributed to all public witnesses, though the judgment singles out PW-9 and PW-10.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Omits the voluntary confession to police, which the judgment treats as relevant conduct under s.8.

custody_duration.reason: The appellant has been in custody for over 10 years since 27.09.2011.

bail_history.reason: Bail history is not mentioned in the judgment.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence/confession 26.09.2011; custody from 27.09.2011; High Court judgment 25.02.2019; Supreme Court decision 02.08.2022
